fresh_leads.location: El Segundo, United States of America
fresh_leads.qualification_text: Minimum Requirements Currently enrolled full-time in an accredited college/university program pursuing a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mathematics or related discipline Availability to work full-time for a minimum of 10 weeks outside of university term and ability to return to a degree program full-time after completion of the internship. Minimum GPA of 3.0 Demonstrated mastery of engineering, mathematical, and scientific fundamentals consistent with your education to date. Experience programming in MATLAB, Python, C++, or another language. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which is issued by the US government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance. Transcripts required. How You Can Stand Out It would be impressive if you have one or more of these: GPA 3.5 or higher Active security clearance Coursework in signals and systems, signal processing, and communication systems Coursework in probability and statistics Experience in engineering design projects. Experience using laboratory hardware. Strong software development skills in MATLAB, Python, or C++ Experience in developing and delivering presentations and working in small groups. Temporary housing assistance is not available. We offer a competitive compensation package where you'll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills. fresh_leads.qualification_text: What you'll bring to Persona Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in computer science, engineering, math, or related discipline with a strong CS background Previous programming experience is a must.
